jobs.title: Coporate Commerical Marketing Manager
jobs.excerpt: About The Role As the Corporate Commercial Marketing Manager for Asia, you will serve as a strategic architect of regional growth.
jobs.description:
About The Role

As the Corporate Commercial Marketing Manager for Asia, you will serve as a strategic architect of regional growth. Your mission is to bridge the gap between high-level business strategy and tactical execution, driving profitability through sophisticated pricing models, rigorous negotiation, and cross-functional leadership within the semiconductor ecosystem.

What you will do

Strategic Optimization & Analysis

  • Drive Profitability: Lead regional initiatives to enhance pricing structures, capture market share, and maximize bottom-line margins.

  • Advanced Modeling: Develop and implement "scientific" pricing models and data-driven simulations to underpin tactical and strategic commercial scenarios.

  • Commercial Strategy: Define and propose strategic directions for "non-pricing" commercial levers to gain a competitive edge.

  • Business Intelligence: Architect and deploy advanced reporting frameworks to empower commercial marketing and quoting centers.

Commercial Execution & Negotiation

  • Regional Negotiations: Spearhead complex RFQ negotiations with major OEM and EMS partners across the Asia region.

  • Pricing Governance: Communicate and execute Pricing Board mandates across Business Groups (BGs) and Global Sales Management (GSM).

  • Operational Excellence: Streamline and optimize end-to-end pricing and quoting workflows to increase organizational agility.

  • Data Integrity: Maintain rigorous oversight of OEM contract pricing, customer master data, and order books to ensure seamless fulfillment and revenue recognition.

Stakeholder & Market Ecosystem Management

  • Strategic Partnerships: Cultivate and manage high-level relationships with key distributors to align regional goals.

  • Cross-Functional Influence: Collaborate with Finance, Sales, and Product Management to resolve price discrepancies and challenge cost-driver assumptions.

  • Market Insight: Act as a regional intelligence hub, gathering and disseminating critical competitor movements and market trends

What you will need

Experience & Education

  • Academic Background: Master’s degree in Business, Engineering, or a related technical field.

  • Industry Expertise: 5+ years of proven success in Marketing, Sales Ops, or Pricing—specifically within the semiconductor or electronic distribution sectors.

  • Domain Knowledge: Deep fluency in semiconductor business processes and the unique dynamics of the Asian distribution landscape.

Technical & Behavioural Competencies

  • Data Mastery: Expert-level Excel proficiency (complex data manipulation, pivot tables, and advanced visualization) to turn raw data into actionable stories.

  • Decisive Communication: The ability to navigate complex decisions into clear, concise proposals and the professional courage to defend "no" when strategic boundaries are tested.

  • Agility: A high-velocity thinker who maintains meticulous attention to detail in a fast-paced environment.

Talent acquisition based on Nexperia vacancies is not appreciated. Nexperia job adverts are Nexperia copyright © material and the word Nexperia® is a registered trademark.

D&I Statement

As an equal-opportunity employer, Nexperia values diversity not just because it is the right thing to do but because diverse teams perform better. We are dedicated to being inclusive, and a proof point of this dedication is that we were the main partner of the very first Dutch Paralympic Team NL House during the Paris 2024 Paralympic Games. Our recruitment process is inclusive and accessible to all, and we consider all applicants fairly, as well as providing a safe work environment and reasonable adjustments where requested.

In addition, we offer our colleagues the possibility to join employee resource groups such as the Pride Network Group or global and local Women's groups. Nexperia is committed to increasing women in management positions to 30% by 2030.

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Software Developer - CRM
jobs.excerpt: 🤙🏼 About gaiiaAt gaiia, we're building the leading platform for Communications Service Providers (CSPs) that truly care about their customers.
jobs.description:
🤙🏼 About gaiia

At gaiia, we're building the leading platform for Communications Service Providers (CSPs) that truly care about their customers. Our core product is an operating system (OS) for telcos that manages billing, operations, automation and everything in between.

We're passionate about taking care of our people, and it's not just lip service. We want you to focus on your job while we care for everything else. We offer competitive pay and benefits, attractive stock options, unparalleled transparency, and a 100% remote environment. We're excited to have you join us for your next career adventure!

🎭 Role & Team

We're looking to hire a Full-Stack Software Developer with excellent technical skills and communication abilities to join our CRM squad.

You will join a team of 3 other Full-Stack Developers (including a Team Lead), one Product Manager, one Quality Assurance Specialist and one Product Designer, dedicated to building core modules of gaiia: Customer, Property and Ticketing Management.

📽 What is your team working on?

Technically speaking, you will work in a serverless ecosystem of microservices deployed on a cloud infrastructure. Gaiia is all-in on Typescript, with frontend, backend and infrastructure-as-code all leveraging Typescript.

As part of the CRM squad, you will have the chance to:

  • Build, in collaboration with talented designers, delightful interfaces that empower our users every day;
  • Be responsible for architecting, developing and owning critical gaiia systems;
  • Collaborate with other legendary full-stack developers;
  • Join a pivotal and central team involved in surprisingly all aspects of the gaiia product

Here are real examples of projects you would have worked on in the last few months:

  • Business operations - built to support our customers’ largest clients by unifying business account management and service delivery projects;
  • Contract management and automation - a self-serve contract manager that lets ISPs generate, send, sign, and renew contracts at scale - fully automated via Workflows and our API;
  • Notifications - a template-driven messaging engine that lets ISPs design custom notifications.

🎖️ Qualifications

  • At least ten (10) years of experience in Software Engineering
  • At least five (5) years of experience in Typescript.
  • Experience with the React library.
  • Experience in DevOps and Cloud providers.
  • Experience with Node.js.

🪄 Nice-to-haves

  • You have experience with GraphQL.
  • You have an interest or expertise in functional programming.
  • You have knowledge of telecom concepts.
  • You have experience working on a System of Record.
  • You have several personal projects exhibiting good coding skills.
  • You have a strong capacity to adapt and a commitment to continuous learning.

💰Salary

At gaiia, we have a transparent salary philosophy and a robust evaluation and compensation framework. It translates to a fair and impartial model where salaries are published internally, healthy discussions around compensation and performance can exist, and taboos are removed.

The salary range for this role is $130,000-$180,000.

🔆 Benefits

  • Flexible 25 days vacation
  • Group Insurance
  • Telemedicine
  • Life Spending Account
  • RRSP & DPSP
  • Flexible working hours & all-remote work
  • Employee Stock Option Plan (ESOP)

We are an equal-opportunity employer committed to inclusivity and diversity. Our workplace is fully remote and boasts accessible technologies, ensuring all team members can thrive. Should you require accommodations due to a disability during the application process, please contact us at 581-996-9639 or as per the Accessible Canada Act and human rights legislation. We're here to support you every step of the way.

jobs.excerpt: Job ID: R-125855Role Summary:Join the Gameplay Programming team at Insomniac Games and gain hands-on experience developing gameplay features that help bring video games to life.
jobs.description:
Job ID: R-125855

Role Summary:

Join the Gameplay Programming team at Insomniac Games and gain hands-on experience developing gameplay features that help bring video games to life.

As a Gameplay Programming Intern, you'll work alongside experienced programmers to create and improve gameplay systems that shape how players interact with the game. You'll contribute to features such as character controls, player abilities, enemy behaviors, and interactive environments while applying your C++ programming skills to real-world game development projects.

Throughout the internship, you'll receive mentorship from senior members of the Gameplay Programming team, strengthen your technical and problem-solving skills, and learn how gameplay features are designed, implemented, and refined in a collaborative game development environment.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Develop and improve gameplay features using C++ while collaborating with experienced programmers.
  • Contribute to gameplay systems involving controls, cameras, characters, breakables, and interactive objects.
  • Support the development of enemy behaviors, player abilities, and other gameplay mechanics that shape the player experience.
  • Work on platform features, trophies, and visual effects as part of gameplay development projects.
  • Investigate, track, and fix bugs to improve gameplay functionality and performance.
  • Collaborate with the Gameplay Programming team to explore technical solutions and learn how gameplay features are developed and refined.
  • Gain hands-on experience with gameplay programming techniques and development workflows through mentorship from senior team members.

What We’re Looking For:

  • Currently pursuing a BS/BSE in Computer Science or Computer Engineering. Students majoring in Physics or Math with computer programming experience will also be considered.
  • Six to twelve months of related experience and/or training is beneficial but not required for currently enrolled students.
  • Ability to program in C++.
  • Strong interest in gameplay programming and using technical skills to create engaging player experiences.
  • A creative, self-motivated, and responsible approach to learning and completing assigned work.
  • Passion for video games and programming, with an interest in developing gameplay features and solving technical challenges.

Eligibility:

  • Students with expected graduation between May 2026 and December 2029 from an accredited university. Undergraduate
  • Able to work during one of the following periods: May 17th - August 6th or June 14th - September 3rd. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates.
  • Must be available for the entire 12-week internship period.

At this time, SIE will only consider applicants who are authorized to work for any employer in the United States and who will not require work visa sponsorship from SIE now or in the future to maintain their authorization to work in the United States.

Our intern positions offer a fixed hourly pay rate. Please note that the pay rate is exclusive to the internship period and may not reflect what pay may look like following the completion of an internship.

At SIE, we consider several factors when setting each role’s base pay range, including the competitive benchmarking data for the market and geographic location.

Please note that the base pay range may vary in line with our hybrid working policy and individual base pay will be determined based on job-related factors which may include knowledge, skills, experience, and location.

Intern Pay Range
$41.50—$50 USD

Please note, Sony Interactive Entertainment conducts background checks at the offer stage for all new employees (which may include criminal background checks for some roles) and will need to process personal information to support these checks.

Please refer to our Candidate Privacy Notice for more information about what personal information we collect, how we use it, who we share it with, and your data protection rights.
